brief: Data pipelines for one-person teams — 6 setups that scale to billions of rows.

slots.title: DuckDB Lake
slots.subtitle: Query billions of Parquet rows directly from object storage with zero infrastructure.
slots.b1Body: Store partitioned Parquet files cheaply without managing a database cluster.
slots.b2Body: DuckDB runs inside your script, eliminating network latency entirely.
slots.b3Body: Pay only for storage and the compute of the machine running queries.

slots.title: dbt Cloud
slots.subtitle: Transform terabytes inside BigQuery using SQL and built-in incremental models.
slots.b1Body: Write pure SQL models that compile down to optimized warehouse queries.
slots.b2Body: Process only new rows on each run to keep costs predictable.
slots.b3Body: Automated testing and documentation generate with every pull request.

slots.title: ClickHouse OLAP
slots.subtitle: Ingest millions of events per second on a single node before sharding.
slots.b1Body: Columnar storage with automatic partitioning keeps query speeds sub-second.
slots.b2Body: Pre-aggregate streams on ingestion to remove heavy compute at read time.
slots.b3Body: Scale out to distributed clusters when one node finally hits its ceiling.

slots.title: Spark Local
slots.subtitle: Prototype on your laptop, then promote the same code to a managed cluster.
slots.b1Body: Use PySpark or Scala locally with identical syntax to production clusters.
slots.b2Body: Spark optimizes shuffles and joins automatically as data volume grows.
slots.b3Body: Move from local mode to Dataproc or EMR without rewriting any logic.

slots.title: Polars DataFrame
slots.subtitle: Rust-powered DataFrames that outperform Pandas by an order of magnitude.
slots.b1Body: Apache Arrow memory format lets you scan files without deserialization overhead.
slots.b2Body: Query plans optimize automatically before touching a single row on disk.
slots.b3Body: Process datasets larger than RAM with automatic chunked execution.

slots.title: Dagster Pipelines
slots.subtitle: Define data assets as code with built-in observability and partition backfills.
slots.b1Body: Declare tables and files as assets instead of fragile task dependencies.
slots.b2Body: Replay a single day or hour without rerunning the entire pipeline.
slots.b3Body: Asset catalog and run logs surface failures before stakeholders notice.

slots.ctaBody: Grab the repo and deploy your first billion-row pipeline in under an hour. No team required.
